title: open_item.opened@4
description: An open item was opened, or revised under the same ID (#323): what a claim left open, quoted as data; #82 adds what a pending or INCONCLUSIVE claim still needs, and #1633 an item opened again after evidence closed it, citing that closing.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Who wrote it, from the connection, never the payload.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

task_ref.description: The task: a task handle, or the message that asked for it (session:<id>#<message>).

item.description: The open item's ID: the hash of its normalized text and its scope (repo, task, requirement).

from.description: What it was read from: the agent's deep_open_item, a final-message section, a bug left or filed as an issue, a limit in the PR body or docs, placeholder text in a changed file, the agent's own task list, or a review thread, or the claim's own verdict: a run or your answer a pending or INCONCLUSIVE requirement still needs.

x-closure.closed: each value is a place the gate reads open items from, and the readers that sort and show items act on each
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

resolved_by.description: Who resolved its review thread when that is the session's own account or token: the agent's word, so the item stays open.

replaces.description: The open_item.closed event this opening replaces: an item raised again after evidence closed it, such as a reviewer resolving its review thread, opens again under the same ID.
